During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the '''Cobalt Flag''' was a terrorist anti-occupation group operating on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The group fought the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] by organizing bombings and sabotage. [[Mia Hawkins]] was part of the group, but quit upon realizing their efforts didn't really work.
